name: openzoo
description: Pay-per-call inference through the local `npx openzoo` proxy: OpenAI-compatible, pays each call over x402 from a local burner wallet, no account. The proxy ignores the API key. The hosted api.openzoo.fun answers 402 unless the caller pays x402 or presents an OpenZoo subscription key (ozk_live_...).

env_vars.name: OPENZOO_HOST
env_vars.description: Base URL of the OpenZoo proxy started with `npx openzoo` (default: http://localhost:8402). Point it at https://api.openzoo.fun only with an ozk_live_ subscription key in OPENZOO_API_KEY.

setup_steps: Run `npx openzoo` (npm package `openzoo`); it listens on http://localhost:8402 and pays each call over x402 from a local burner wallet. No account needed.
OPENZOO_API_KEY is optional: the proxy ignores it, so any value (e.g. sk-openzoo) works. Leave OPENZOO_HOST at the default unless the proxy runs elsewhere (Docker: http://host.docker.internal:8402).
